triggers.description: Current or historical owner-issued falsification evidence needs current classification.
Several observations may support one same-law observational class or family hypothesis.
exclusions: duplicate reports or copied tests alone

triggers.description: Changed accepted authority requires current evidence to be reclassified against the new Goal.

routes.description: Return the current analytical Review Fold.
Block a classification when evidence, applicability, provenance, law, class basis, or identity is unknown.

success_signals: claims, facts, suggested repairs, and transport status are separate
law boundaries and witness detection boundaries are distinct
output is returned directly to Actuating
failure_signals: historical evidence is rebound as though observed at the current head
a detection boundary is presented as an admission frontier
unknown evidence is treated as current
a Counterexample Set, hotspot artifact, or Ledger record is created
clauses.rationale: Classification remains current analysis while preserving the owner-issued subject of every witness.

required_artifacts: current owner set and owner status
success_signals: duplicates collapse without collapsing independent witnesses
different detection surfaces and current owners may remain one same-law observational class
observed witnesses support but do not define the complete family
file proximity never defines a class
recurrence is established only from exact available prior evidence
failure_signals: attempt, patch, file, reviewer, or current owner identity defines a class
duplicate reports count as independent witnesses
observed examples are asserted as the complete family
memory or summary manufactures recurrence or applicability
Review Fold selects a family partition, admission frontier, admission cut, candidate owner, or repair
clauses.rationale: Actuating receives current observational evidence without a retained class register or a cyclic frontier assumption.

required_artifacts: currently available owner evidence with original witness subjects
success_signals: all available relevant evidence is reclassified under current authority
failure_signals: source revision erases known current evidence
historical evidence is rewritten to match the current source
clauses.rationale: Current owner facts are reinterpreted directly without copying or rewriting their provenance.

instrumentation.rationale: The Review Fold is returned in the active workflow; durable facts remain with their source owners.
